requirements.title: Product Principles

sourceClauses.assessmentType: context

sourceClauses.text: Proof before pitch — working products and verified contribution matter more than self-written skill claims.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: Business-problem-first discovery — clients search for CRM, SaaS, e-commerce, booking, inventory, AI automation, dashboards, etc.; technology filters are secondary.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: Low client friction — browsing is public; inquiry is lightweight; account creation is not forced before a client sees value.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: Trust is earned, not bought — verification, reviews, response reliability, and marketplace outcomes cannot be directly purchased.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: Quality beats volume — curated builders and strong showcases are more important than registration count.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: No bidding race-to-the-bottom — clients discover evidence and choose builders; the product avoids mass proposal spam.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: External contracts/payments in V1 — the platform proves lead generation first.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: Global destination, curated launch — any geography and software category may eventually participate, but initial content is manually approved.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: Monetize value, not access — clients browse and inquire freely; paid tiers later sell business tools, capacity, analytics, recruiting, and workflow.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: Build only what validates the marketplace — teams, payments, source-code sales, AI matching, and hosted demos come later.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

requirements.title: Implementation addendum — 14 September 2026

sourceClauses.assessmentType: context

sourceClauses.text: PUT /developer/profile accepts optional websiteUrl (public HTTPS), country (ISO alpha-2), timeZone (IANA) and languages (text, max 200). Omitting an optional field preserves its stored value; empty string clears it. These fields are included in approved public builder profiles and moderation evidence. Material edits require re-review.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: POST /inquiries/{id}/review and review-token confirmation accept visibility: ANONYMOUS (default) or NAMED. Client workspace alias shares the same validation. Public builder review responses include id and clientName; anonymous reviews return Verified client, named reviews return the inquiry's client name. Email is never returned. Replaying identical review text/rating/visibility is harmless; changing an already-submitted review returns REVIEW_EXISTS.

requirements.title: Implementation addendum — 15 September 2026

sourceClauses.assessmentType: context

sourceClauses.text: DELETE /me initiates account closure and returns 202 with status EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. The account remains active until the emailed ACCOUNT_DELETION token is confirmed through POST /auth/confirm with decision DELETE. The token expires after 15 minutes; repeated confirmation is idempotent. Confirmation revokes sessions/tokens and hides public content, while final retention/purge remains a staff policy workflow. The sole administrator cannot close this way.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: GET /developer/products accepts lifecycleStatus and approvalStatus, validates their enum values, and filters before page/size pagination. totalOwned counts all owner showcases; activeCount is independent of the selected page/filter.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: GET /me/saved-products accepts optional ids, a comma-separated list of at most 50 UUIDs, to look up saved state for a visible gallery page. The normal paginated collection remains available when ids is omitted.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: GET /products/{slug} includes reviewSummary {reviewCount, averageRating}. These are builder-wide published reviews for confirmed completed, unrestricted inquiries. With no reviews, reviewCount is 0 and averageRating is null. Public and granted-client product responses omit moderationReason; owner and administrator management responses retain it.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: POST /inquiries accepts the recommended Idempotency-Key UUID when present. When omitted, the server assigns an internal key and still applies duplicate and rate-limit rules. Reuse a client key for idempotent retries.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

sourceClauses.text: POST /reports permits anonymous reports and treats invalid/revoked/expired/suspended sessions as anonymous. Protected endpoints still require an active valid session. Database errors are not converted into anonymous authorization.
sourceClauses.assessmentType: source requirement or guidance; inherit section evidence

gaps.summary: Hosted frontend Content-Security-Policy blocks Razorpay Checkout
gaps.action: Review official gateway CSP and permit the exact lazy Checkout script/frame/connect origins; preserve frame-ancestors and validate Worker-header behavior.

gaps.summary: Personal workspace retains stale protected records after failed refresh/session revocation
gaps.action: Clear personal/admin state on failed protected refresh; provide labelled login/retry and negative revoked-session regression.

gaps.summary: Public policy wording describes only V1 external agreements/payments
gaps.action: Update draft notices for recorded agreements, provider Route payment boundary, source license/version, entitlement and refund/dispute workflow without claiming legal approval.

gaps.summary: Legacy inquiry/moderation history has no database append-only guard
gaps.action: Add new migration guarding UPDATE/DELETE of inquiry_events and moderation_actions; preserve prior released migrations and add mutation-rejection test.

gaps.summary: V3.5 commerce missing from baseline main
gaps.action: Incoming commerce leaf: reviewed source package, manifest/README/LICENSE, ownership/rights, bounded archive and secret/executable checks, private storage/hash, snapshot/license purchase and live entitlement, provider refund/dispute/MFA recovery, scoped export/retention, connected UI/API/database tests.

gaps.summary: Analytics collection exists but required operational dashboards are incomplete
gaps.action: Add real aggregate APIs/UI for current approved builders/showcases/proof coverage, response/hire/completion conversion, repeat clients, slot utilization/events, reports/severity/appeals/reversals/IP/link incidents. Liquidity needs stored search result-count cohort and consent-aware event limits; do not fake statistics.

gaps.summary: Public search GET lacks a dedicated configured rate limit
gaps.action: Throttle bounded public discovery reads using trusted client identity and configured generous read limit; preserve per-user mutation limits and tested Retry-After.

gaps.summary: Original six journeys are service-smoke verified, not all independently browser driven
gaps.action: Preserve actual browser V2.5/V3 journey; add full browser onboarding/publication/slots/inquiry/outcomes/review/moderation as coverage allows. Never equate service HTTP smoke or mocked preview with all six browser E2E.

gaps.summary: Locks exist; whole-repository vulnerability/license/SBOM verification is not configured
gaps.action: Add meaningful dependency/secret/static/license checks or record exact existing checker evidence; operator must decide license compatibility and patches. Do not claim a lockfile is a vulnerability scan.

gaps.summary: Optional showcase structured price modes are represented only by free-text pricing context
gaps.action: Implement mode/minor min/max/currency and client-readable display if keeping original optional pricing contract, or explicitly approve/document the narrower free-text adaptation. V3 milestone and V3.5 checkout amounts are already distinct and must stay server selected.

gaps.summary: Teams share individually owned proof but do not own products or structured contributor records
gaps.action: Document individual ownership adaptation. Real team ownership/contributors requires a scoped authorization/consent/data migration; do not invent ownership or weaken existing consent to close a schema label.

gaps.summary: Public team routes are absent from sitemap generation
gaps.action: Include only genuinely public eligible team pages under indexing gate, with private/suspended exclusions and metadata tests.

gaps.summary: Production/nonfunctional acceptance is not code completeness
gaps.action: Owner: real OAuth/email/S3/TLS/alerts, daily/PITR/object backups, measured RPO/RTO and load, Firefox/Safari/Edge and screen-reader/contrast WCAG checks, legal/contacts/retention/vendor/age policies, curated cohort and live provider acceptance. Current user permits demo frontend hosting only.

newWork.status: in progress; source/tests/CI not yet audited
incoming: connected seller/buyer/operator UI and isolated preview
ownerPending: Live Razorpay Route/KYC/merchant activation and public signed webhook
Backend production hosting and provider staging acceptance are not deployed by this task

passes.result: Entire seventeen source texts read; exact clauses mapped; original source hashes retained and current text SHA-256 computed.
Phase and legal precedence checked; original V1 no-payments wording cannot erase V3 scope; JDBC/team-ownership adaptations are explicit; no compliance or live-provider claim.

Concrete worker CSP, stale protected personal state, policy drift, legacy append-only, analytics/read limits and full-stack commerce gaps sent to parent; confirmed embedded V3 connected browser test exists.
Stable FR/NFR/E2E IDs preserved; all nonblank source lines mapped; evidence paths checked; mixed source/owner/future outcomes do not become an invented completion percentage.

resolutions.evidenceAndLimits: Connected-only Checkout CSP, lazy script loading and Worker header checks; demo admits no gateway origins.
Protected personal/admin refresh failures clear records; revoked-session connected regression.
Current agreement, Route, source license, privacy and retention notices.
V17 append-only inquiry/moderation history; real database mutation-denial tests.
Java source marketplace, V16 private artifacts, immutable purchases, MFA review/recovery, refunds/disputes, export and connected UI.
Real aggregate dashboard; V20 capacity observations and structured report decisions; consented recommendation/result-count samples. Legacy unrecorded durations/decisions remain unknown.
Configurable trusted-identity discovery throttle and Retry-After negative controls.

resolutions.disposition: Service coverage plus selected browser coverage
resolutions.evidenceAndLimits: All six original real service journeys stay in Docker smoke. Connected hiring/delivery and source/revoked-session browser flows run at three widths. Not every service journey is independently browser driven.

resolutions.disposition: Implemented inventory/scan; operator license review pending
resolutions.evidenceAndLimits: Runtime CycloneDX and OSV CI, npm audit, dependency remediation and JAR test-fixture exclusion. Declared licenses are inventory, not legal approval.
V18 optional showcase pricing modes/currency/minor amounts; server/SQL validation; frontend display/forms and precision tests. No showcase checkout.

Teams share consenting members’ individually owned proof. Source sellers are individuals. Organization-owned products and structured contributor entities require an additional ownership/consent design and are not implemented.
Indexing-gated eligible public team/template sitemap using real team UUID routes.
Real provider/OAuth/email/storage credentials, production hosting, observed backups/load/alerts, policies/KYC and broad accessibility/browser acceptance. Only frontend demo hosting is authorized.
